name: @polymarket-bot/trading-core
description: The shared deterministic trading core (ADR-022): createPaperTrader, CoreLoop and the modules in their import closure, moved byte for byte from apps/trader by CORE-MOVE so that both composition roots build one core. Layer 1 (dependency-direction.md §2): layer-0 and layer-1 workspace packages plus zod; no adapter, no Node built-in, no clock read. PAPER only — simulated execution, no credential, no signer, no venue connection, no real order.
